title: BPW-2026-0627
text:
[CONSENT ITEM(S)]
BPW-2026-0627
AFE – STATE WATER RESOURCES CONTROL BOARD
Bureau of Sanitation and Office of Accounting are requesting Board approval and execution of an Authority for Expenditure in the amount of $628,635 for encumbrance of funds to pay for the annual National Pollutant Discharge Elimination System and Storm Water fees as required by the State of California - State Water Resources Control Board for the period covering July 1, 2026 through June 30, 2027.
(AE27760508M, Fund 760 - Sewer Operations & Maintenance Fund, Dept. 50, Appropriation Unit 50EX82)
